subject: Clarifying cloud carve-out coverage and evidence sequencing for SOC 2 Type II — Finnova
messages:
From: Olivia Ramirez <olivia@finnova.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finnova.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 Type II — cloud provider carve-out & evidence sequencing question

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for taking this. We're prepping for a November compliance submission and our auditors asked for clarification on Redwood's handling of cloud provider SOC reports and related evidence for our SOC 2 Type II loop. A few specific asks: 

1) Carve-out coverage: We see that AWS's SOC 2 is used as a subservice report in several places. Can you confirm whether Redwood accepts an AWS SOC 2 with a carve-out for managed services (S3, KMS, EBS snapshots) for the period Jan 1 — Sep 30, 2026, and whether you'll provide a bridge letter to cover any gap with Redwood's own audit period?

2) Evidence sequencing: Our auditor wants a short walk-through of how we (Finnova) should present the chain of evidence. Practical examples: where to point for logs, key custody, and subprocessor attestations; and must we provide separate artifacts for each data flow (e.g., backups to S3 + KMS-wrapped keys)?

3) Subprocessor list & responsibilities: please confirm the current list of Redwood subprocessors that are relevant to cloud storage and key management. If you can provide a one-page mapping (service -> subprocessor -> evidence pointer), that would help speed the review.

4) Timeline: can Redwood turn these artifacts around within 5–7 business days? Our audit window is mid-November and we'd prefer to have the mapping + bridge letter by Oct 20 if possible.

I've attached the vendor questionnaire excerpt the auditor flagged for context. Appreciate any short-format guidance we can include in our submission.

Thanks,
Olivia Ramirez
Head of Vendor Risk | Finnova Health
[Attachment: finnova_vendor_q_excerpt.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II — cloud provider carve-out & evidence sequencing question (Finnova)

Aisha — quick summary and proposed plan below. Reply inline to speed review.

Summary: Redwood accepts cloud provider SOC 2 reports (e.g., AWS) as subservice reports for carve-out scopes, but auditors frequently require either (a) a bridge letter from us addressing the coverage gap for the customer's audit window or (b) evidence that the customer's audit window is fully covered by the CSP's SOC report period + our own controls. We can produce a standardized bridge letter for this purpose.

Key notes: 
- KMS / key custody: This is a shared responsibility. For KMS-backed customer keys (customer-managed keys), we can provide metadata showing key last-rotation and IAM policy snapshots. For Redwood-managed keys (we manage keys on behalf of customers), we will provide a key custody attestation and timestamped keystore snapshot.
- S3 backups / snapshot evidence: we can provide an export of backup job manifests and a sample S3 object listing (redacted), plus object metadata (creation/last-modified). We will not include customer data in exports; we provide metadata and checksums where the auditor needs evidence of retention/immutability.
- Subprocessors: current list relevant to storage/key workflows: AWS (us-east-1), HashiCorp Vault (key escrow for some customers), FastBackup Inc. (managed snapshot service). I'll attach a brief one-page mapping.

Proposed deliverables (we can turn-around in ~4 business days):
1) Populated subservice mapping (xlsx) — I'll fill S3/KMS rows.
2) Draft bridge letter (PDF) — attached: redwood_bridge_letter_template.pdf. Use this as the starting doc; Legal signs final.
3) Evidence pointers: list of Drive links to exported manifests and metadata (we'll host these in a secure Drive folder).

Karthik — can you confirm the location of the backup manifests and whether we can produce an S3 object-listing export and keystore snapshot for a single sample tenant? If yes, estimate time.

Next steps:
- Karthik to confirm exports (target: Mon 12 Oct).
- I will finalize the bridge letter language (target: Tue 13 Oct) and route to Legal.
- Aisha to coordinate delivery to Finnova once we have exports + signed bridge letter.

Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_template.pdf

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: SOC2 Type II — cloud provider carve-out & evidence sequencing question

Hi Olivia — thanks for the note and the questionnaire excerpt. Apologies for the delay while we lined up resources. Below is our proposed plan and timeline; happy to hop on a short call to walk through if that helps.

What Redwood will provide: 
1) Populated subservice mapping (attached) that maps the relevant services (S3 backups, KMS) to Redwood responsibilities and our subprocessors. See attached: finnova_subservice_matrix.xlsx.
2) Draft bridge letter: we prepared a template and will route to Legal for signature. The draft is attached for your reference (redwood_bridge_letter_template.pdf). Final legal-signed copy will be provided as soon as signatures are complete.
3) Evidence exports: sample backup manifests (redacted), S3 object listings (metadata only), and a keystore metadata snapshot for a single sample tenant. These will be shared via a secure Drive folder and we will provide links in our delivery email.

Timeline: 
- Today (Oct 12): deliver populated mapping + draft bridge letter for your review (attached).
- Tue Oct 13: we will share secure Drive links to the evidence exports (manifests, object metadata, keystore snapshot).
- Wed Oct 14–15: Legal signs bridge letter (if no major edits) and we deliver final signed copy.

Action items for Finnova auditor: 
- Please confirm the audit coverage dates you need the bridge letter to span (our template assumes Oct 1 — Nov 30, 2026 for overlap; specify if different).
- Let us know if you require the raw manifests in a specific format or a pushed SFTP export; otherwise we'll provide Drive links with CSV/JSON manifests and checksums.

I've cc'd BlueBridge Audit per your earlier note so they have visibility into our commitments. If you'd like a 30-min call to walk through the mapping, I can coordinate times for Tue morning PST.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
